## formatUnion() function

Humanizes an array of strings into a comma-separated list with an "or" before the last item. For example, \["a", "b", "c"\] becomes "a, b or c".

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function formatUnion(items: string[]): string;
```

## Example


```ts
import { formatUnion } from "@morpho-org/morpho-ts";

const value = formatUnion(["supply", "borrow", "withdraw"]);
// "supply, borrow or withdraw"
```
